integrity: The exact graph/face identification, acyclic matching, retraction and relative integral inclusion proof are written in RESULT.md; verify.py gives finite cross-checks but is not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Classification at the first reverse-arc domination budget only for cycle lengths divisible by three; stability before the budget holds for every cycle. No post-threshold or equivariant classification. Published-literature overlap may be incomplete.
title: The period-three reverse-arc threshold for multipath complexes of directed polygons
